title: Every new signup lands on the DAWN induction after the first Frequency join screen

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: app/join/(induction)/page.tsx:117-126 shows FrequencyJoin only on a bare /join. Its own forms (components/frequency/site/pages/join/*.tsx:109,134) send people back with a persona, which renders FunnelInduction: 1,300 lines with no SITE_DESIGN branch, DAWN's .brandmark wordmark and bg-canvas (line 686). About 25 call sites link /join?seq=, ?persona= or ?next=, which skip the Frequency screen entirely. The first-session funnel is the old design. THE FIX: a Frequency induction body per the handoff's Join template, branched on SITE_DESIGN like the other ported pages.
